hook: *₹4,350 crore*, 10,000 km of AI fibre. Hyderabad is on the first route
tldr: Tata Communications will build about 10,000 km of AI-ready fibre between FY2030 and FY2036, starting with the Mumbai–Pune–Hyderabad–Chennai data centre corridor. It adds ~6 Pbps to today's 1.25 Pbps capacity.

beats.what: Phase 1 links data centre hubs in Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad and Chennai; later phases reach Vizag, Bhubaneswar, Jamnagar and GIFT City.
beats.why: AI workloads need huge data-centre-to-data-centre bandwidth. Current utilisation is already 70–80%.
beats.care: More data centres and AI jobs for Hyderabad's corridor. India holds ~20% of the world's data but only 3% of data centre capacity.

cards.q: Which route does Tata Communications build first?
cards.why: The first phase covers the Mumbai–Pune–Hyderabad–Chennai corridor.

sources.name: The Hindu
sources.title: Tata Communications plans 10,000-km AI network at ₹4,350 cr. (print, Hyderabad edition, 27 Oct, p.11)
